Adeka Al Ghurair Additives LLC.event: renamed to ADEKA AL OTAIBA MIDDLE EAST LLC after Mohammed Al Otaiba Group acquired its shares
Adeka Al Ghurair Additives LLC.evidence: According to the official ADEKA Corporation company history, Mohammed Al Otaiba Group acquired the shares of Adeka Al Ghurair Additives LLC in 2019 and renamed the entity to ADEKA AL OTAIBA MIDDLE EAST LLC.

Bruno Bock Chemische Fabrik GmbH & Co. K.evidence: According to the company's website, Bruno Bock operates under the domain thiochem.com with its headquarters in Marschacht, Germany. In December 2021, the company sold its Evanstab® secondary antioxidants (thioester) business to Reagens USA, exiting the antioxidant additive market.

Chemiedis Sdn. Bhd..evidence: The company's website confirms its identity as Chemiedis Sdn. Bhd., headquartered in Klang, Malaysia, and notes it has been operating since 2014. The website explicitly states they manufacture an 'Antioxidants Series' of water-based chemical dispersions to protect latex-related products from oxidative degradation.

Prodacor.evidence: Prodacor S.A.S. (also registered as Prodacor Ltda.) exists as a registered microenterprise in Bogota, Colombia, operating in retail or multilevel commerce. Chamber of commerce records and trade directories indicate it is active but show no involvement with chemical antioxidant additives for rubber or polymer formulations.

Raika Pajouhesh Chemical Industries.evidence: The company's LinkedIn profile and company directories confirm its existence and list http://www.raikachemical.com as its official website. Its active market status is demonstrated by its participation in trade shows and product focus on Antioxidant SP and styrenated phenol for the rubber and polymer industry.
